g.text: Accuracy and precision describe different features of repeated measurements

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Targets are conceptual, not probability estimates. Precision describes replicate agreement; accuracy concerns agreement with a reference/true value. A
centered average does not make individual widely scattered readings accurate. Correcting bias does not automatically improve repeatability.
